title: Decide the GDEX builder fee for the house account
description: Measured taker cost 0.0932% per side = HL 0.0432% + GDEX builder 0.05%. At 40x a round trip is 7.5% of margin; the builder fee is 54% of that. Lowering or waiving it for this account is a company decision.
close_reason: Owner decision 2026-11-22: the GDEX builder fee stays as is. The point is to show the product works for a normal user paying normal fees.

title: GDEX bug: reduce-only place_order closes at market instead of resting
description: 2026-11-22 20:08 UTC: hlPlaceOrder {BTC, sell, price 63715, reduceOnly true} on a long from 60681 filled at 60680 as a taker (crossed=true) instead of resting at 63715. Blocks resting take-profit orders. degen.js tp --maker is disabled until fixed. Check /v1/hl/place_order handling of reduceOnly.
close_reason: Not a bug: place_order is the site close button (closes at market by design; gdex.pro uses it). Harness now rests take-profits through create_order with reduceOnly + isMarket false: tp --maker, live-tested 2026-11-22 (rested at target, moved, position intact). Back-end branch fix/hl-limit-mark-and-reduce-only (worktree ~/wt-hl-order-fixes, commit fec7907b) adds an explicit limit mode to place_order; gdex-skill docs wrongly call hlPlaceOrder limit-only.

title: GDEX bug: resting-entry check uses a stale mark price
description: Back-end getMarketableOpeningLimitOrderError compared a long limit against mark 60699 while the real HL mark was 60722-60726 for several minutes (2026-11-22 ~20:00 UTC). Top-of-book limit entries are refused. degen.js --join works around it by re-planning one cushion inside the mark named in the error.
notes: REASSESSED 2026-11-22 against front-end origin/main 94cb46af and back-end origin/master 983b8eaa: comparing a limit entry with the MARK (not best bid/ask) is the product rule - gdex.pro blocks the same thing client-side using the live mark. The only defect is that the back-end uses a cached registry mark (up to ~7 min old). The local branch fix/hl-limit-mark-and-reduce-only (rebased, 77ad455a, 519 targeted tests pass) changes the rule to best bid/ask AND adds a place_order limit mode that is not needed (limit close already exists via create_order reduce-only). Recommended instead: keep the mark rule, make the mark fresh. Branch stays local, not pushed.

title: Replay: level setups with the tracker as a filter
description: replay.js. Result 2026-11-22 (8 markets, 15m, 3R target, stops >= 0.75% of price): fades -0.087R after fees (t -0.7), breakouts +0.014R (t 0.2); breakouts with tracker lock +0.146R (n=89, t 0.8). 1h: all negative. Nothing statistically solid.
close_reason: Built and run; results in research/FINDINGS.md

title: gdex-skill: hlPlaceOrder is documented as limit-only but the back-end closes at market
description: gdex-skill src/actions/perpTrade.ts documents hlPlaceOrder as a limit order call. The back-end place_order endpoint only closes positions at market and ignores the price. A reduce-only limit sent through it closed a live position on 2026-11-22. Fix the SDK docs/validation, or send the new isMarket=false 7th field once back-end branch fix/hl-limit-mark-and-reduce-only ships.
notes: Full list of SDK vs site differences is in the session findings: hlPlaceOrder documented as a limit order but is the close button (non-reduce-only is rejected, price ignored); getHlMarkPrice returns mid not mark; hlUpdateLeverage has no back-end route (leverage is the top-level field on create_order); SKILL says omitted leverage = 20x but the back-end uses 5x isolated for dex markets and leaves cross unchanged; hl_modify_order and hl_add_position_tpsl are missing from the SDK; closePerpPosition cannot load on Node 20.

title: Tracker: innovation-driven model switching
description: arXiv 2610.11242: drive the IMM transition probabilities from the normalized innovation instead of a fixed 94% stay probability.
close_reason: Built (track.js --adaptive) and replayed: no better than fixed switching (trend-ride -0.102% vs -0.041% per trade). Left off by default.

title: Tracker on spreads (pairs)
description: Published Kalman trading results are on spreads (arXiv 2210.15448, 2302.05993). Try track.js on ETH/BTC and on the same stock across venues (xyz:NVDA vs io:NVDA). Two legs double the fees.
close_reason: Built (track.js --pairs) and replayed: worse than single markets, two legs double the fees (-0.41% per trade after fees over 490 band trades). Not pursued.
